mode: direct — the host agent reviews; the copilot makes zero LLM calls
measures: the Direct integration as a whole (MCP + imreview skill + protocol prompt), NOT knowledge routing in isolation

isolation.skills: disabled on BOTH arms (--disable-slash-commands); enabling them would have added 16 bundled skills incl. a built-in code-review that the baseline lacks

imreview_protocol: inlined into the prompt from the shipped SKILL.md (read at run time, not copied)
pr_context: frozen snapshot (no_discussion), byte-identical to the pinned baseline's
completion_gate: exactly one successful review(mode=direct) + a successful validate_direct_review, read from events
